title: Hermes agents and a guided CloudlessOS experience
summary: CloudlessOS now integrates Hermes as its built-in agent system and makes the core interface easier to understand, configure, and navigate.
changes: Use the built-in Cloudless Assistant powered by Hermes, with local, network, and optional public gateway access managed inside CloudlessOS.
Open app dashboards inside the CloudlessOS shell and manage installed apps through native install and uninstall dialogs.
Choose models with a redesigned Model Manager, expanded compatibility guidance, and current Qwen and DeepSeek catalog entries.
Configure the machine, inference engine, API access, and Hermes from a consistent full-size Settings experience.
Follow a new action-guided welcome tour that highlights the real controls while keeping the rest of the interface safely blurred and locked.
Benefit from more reliable model recommendations, API-key usage metrics, WSL GPU detection, and protected Hermes defaults.
